title: Home Inspection Work Order
subtitle: Home Condition Inspection: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Home Inspection Work Order covers visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern. The home inspection coordinator records Home Condition Inspection authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Home Inspection Work Order keeps Home Condition Inspection exceptions visible until the home inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Home Inspection Work Order at residence exterior, interior, accessible attic, visible foundation, and installed systems. Document visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern identity before Home Condition Inspection begins. Compare visible building system, component, room, exterior area, and reported concern findings with stated Home Condition Inspection criteria; route unresolved Home Condition Inspection issues to qualified home-condition reviewer. For Home Inspection Work Order, confirm requirements for Home Condition Inspection. Ask qualified home-condition reviewer to review Home Condition Inspection conditions beyond the home inspection coordinator's role.
